description: Side drawer showing the Gantt audit log with time-travel and rollback.

parameters.name: OnClose
parameters.description: Fires when the drawer should close (close button or Escape).

parameters.name: OnRollbackRequested
parameters.description: Fires when the user confirms the rollback of a history entry (the drawer asks for confirmation first).

parameters.name: OnTimeTravelRequested
parameters.description: Fires when the user requests time-travel to a specific timestamp.

parameters.name: TimeZone
parameters.description: Zone the entry timestamps are shown in. Defaults to the machine's local zone; TmGantt passes the user's display zone.

parameters.name: Tasks
parameters.description: Tasks the entries refer to: resolves the task titles shown (and linked) in each entry.

parameters.name: Placement
parameters.description: What the drawer is positioned against: the Gantt component (default) or the viewport.

parameters.name: OnTaskSelected
parameters.description: Fires when the user clicks the task of an entry (arg = task id).
